svg.title: SOTIF modifications: P1 modifications (WP-C-07)
svg.desc: Figure 3-1: 6 cards, one per WP-C-07 modification with priority P1. FM-01 Experimental Mode off and locked in the reference configuration (P1): today, Chill is the default on new installs, but the owner can still turn Experimental Mode on, and a stored 1 persists. With it: Removes SH-09 from scope and the e2e contribution to SH-03/SH-04 FM-02 Exclude Chestnut big model; remove diagnostic masking (P1): today, Diagnostics are masked while the big model loads; a failure hot-switches to a model with zero recurrent state. With it: Removes TC-22 as a trigger; restores fault detection coverage for SH-01/SH-02 FM-03 No actuation on stale or failed inputs during soft disable (P1): today, Soft disable keeps actuating on the input that just failed for up to ≈3.5 s, about 100 m at 30 m/s. With it: Bounds actuation on invalid inputs to the freshness bound; supports FSR-02.02, FSR-06.02 FM-04 React to cruiseMismatch; correct canError text; fault on non-finite commands (P1): today, cruiseMismatch raises an event with no reaction; canError shows the wrong text; non-finite commands are clamped to 0. With it: Removes TC-30 as unhandled; correct driver information on CAN faults FM-05 DM source validity and wheel-touch fallback hardening (P1): today, The wheel-touch fallback resets awareness on any steering or gas input; DM source validity is always True. With it: Reduces SH-12 duration; supports FSR-02.07 FM-06 Lock out debug, maneuver, joystick and DM demo modes (P1): today, One local parameter can replace control processes or neutralise DM; lateralManeuverPlan overrides model curvature. With it: Removes TC-26; supports FSR-02.08
svg.text: Each modification of WP-C-07: what the car does today, against the same scene with the modification in place.

Experimental Mode on, and a stored 1 persists.

Chill). Matches the recommendation in WP-C-02 §6.4 (D-08, …

(model selection forced to the on-device model; WP-C-01 OI-4).
(b) Independently of (a), remove the masking of commIssue, …

to ≈3.5 s, about 100 m at 30 m/s.
Split soft-disable causes into (i) degradation causes, where
control inputs remain valid (thermal, disk, memory), which keep
the 3 s warning period, and (ii) input-loss causes (commIssue …

the wrong text; non-finite commands are clamped to 0.
(a) cruiseMismatch: on persistence, warn and repeat PCM
cancel; if it persists, immediate-disable alert and lockout until
restart. Reduce the 6 s delay to a value justified by analysis. …

Today and status texts quote WP-C-07, WP-C-04, WP-C-02 and the gap assessment; the build fails if a quoted passage changes. P1: before on-road operation beyond safety-driver testing; P2: before G5; P3: decide at G2.
